title: On Private Knowledge Retrieval and Private Inference for secure multi-agent systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.13696v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-agent systems provide a convenient framework for the massive deployment of agents based on Large Language Models (LLMs). It provides a sound framework where agents can interact with existing software to perform actions in an autonomous way. Agentic AI is the new term to denote these AI-based autonomous systems.   In real multi-agent systems, agents need to deal with malicious agents some of which can exploit security vulnerabilities to do harm. A memory poisoning attack is an example of exploiting a vulnerability to modify agents knowledge and, thus, affect its behavior. translated_title: 面向安全多智能体系统的私有知识检索与私有推理研究
translated_abstract: 多智能体系统为基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体的大规模部署提供了一个便捷的框架。它为智能体提供了一个健全的框架，使其能够与现有软件交互并自主地执行操作。智能体AI（Agentic AI）是用于指代这类基于AI的自主系统的新术语。在真实的多智能体系统中，智能体需要应对恶意智能体，其中一些恶意智能体会利用安全漏洞进行破坏。记忆投毒攻击就是一种利用漏洞修改智能体知识、进而影响其行为的例子。智能体中存在不同类型的记忆系统（语义记忆、情景记忆和短期记忆），它们各有特点，针对它们可能发展出不同的记忆投毒攻击。本文聚焦于语义记忆，讨论了针对它的攻击以及缓解策略，并提出了私有知识检索与私有推理。
tldr: 本文针对多智能体系统中语义记忆面临的记忆投毒攻击，提出了私有知识检索与私有推理作为防御与缓解策略，以保障智能体系统的安全。
en_tdlr: This paper addresses memory poisoning attacks on semantic memory in secure multi-agent systems by introducing private knowledge retrieval and private inference as mitigation strategies.
